answer_1.quote: We design a set of dialog policy models that adapt to the dialog context to appropriately control the responses at both the turn and sentence-levels ... Our proposed PD-NRG approach has two parts: a dialog policy ... and a response generation model that takes the action plan and the dialog context as input to generate a response.

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation we compute a set of metrics between our generated and ground truth response: perplexity, BLEU-1, ROUGE-L, unigram F1-score. We also compute n-gram diversity as defined in ...

answer_4.quote: For human evaluation, we followed a similar setup as ... generated 200 snippets which contain a dialog context of 5 turns. We generated responses from 2 models to compare against. We asked a set of 3 crowd workers "Which final response is more appropriate for the given conversation?"
answer_4.guideline: Crowd workers were asked to select the response that is more appropriate for the given conversation (or indicate a tie).
